subject: FRMT baselines: entity bucket catches real drift
body:
Hi Ivo,

Baseline results are in. On the lexical bucket, our production model handles pt-BR vs pt-PT lexical choice reasonably (about 85% preferred-variant agreement) but the entity bucket exposes exactly the failure FRMT was designed to catch: on pages strongly tied to Portugal, the model drifts into European Portuguese for 18% of pt-BR requests. Mandarin shows the same pattern between Mainland and Taiwan variants, slightly milder.

Few-shot helps a lot — ten exemplars sampled at the document level cut entity-bucket drift roughly in half — but results are sensitive to which exemplar documents we pick, which is a reproducibility risk for the dashboard.

Proposal: fix a frozen exemplar set per language pair for dashboard runs.

Yara
